## LTX-2 Prompting Tips
1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene  
3. **Reference Image**: Do not repeat details already present  
4. **Consistency**: Avoid instructions that do not match the reference image, as this will degrade results

widgets_values: This automagically enhances your prompt using the already loaded Gemma model. But it can be a bit sensitive to having correct Gemma if using GGUF models. Alternatively you can bypass/disable  this feature
nodes.title: Prompt Enhancer (Optional)

widgets_values:
**SET UNIQUE FOLDER NAME PER RUN:**  

This **must** be set to a unique name (string with no spaces and with standard characters). 

This will be a temporary save directory for the frames generated.  

**Alternatively you can delete the content of the folder, before running next run. It might be wise to have this folder open in your file explorer**

Located in **comfyui/output/MusicVideo**
nodes.title: IMPORTANT - Temp folder

widgets_values:
The **start_index** can be used to continue from last generated video of a song. For example if the first video you made was 58 seconds long, set the start index to 58 to continue. And then combine those manually (there is a video combine workflow in the helper folder on Huggingface) 

The **duration**  must be as long (or longer) than the total duration of the video you are making. In theory you can set it all the way to the end of the mp3 input, but you might want to set it closer to the expected video duration to not have to encode more audio than you need in the workflow
nodes.title: AUDIO START FROM AND DURATION

widgets_values:
If low on Ram/Vram, try  768x512, 832x480 or 960x544.  With higher Vram you can try 1280x736 or 1920x1088

Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 

Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters. 

**Length in seconds:**  try 5, 10 or 20. 

**FPS:** 24 or 25 (or 48 if your pc can run it)
nodes.title: Video settings

widgets_values:
It can greatly improve the results if you transcribe the lyrics for each segment in the prompt 

For example: 

And she sings: "...... "
nodes.title: LIP-SYNC

widgets_values:
**AUDIO START FROM:** 
 For a longer music video, you can create multiple renders in a row. And use the "Trim Audio" node **start index** to set where you want to continue from. For example if the first render was 50 seconds, you can set start index to 50 seconds, and continue render the song from there

----

Mel-band RoFormer is optional for extracting a clean vocal only audio for the sampler. This can be useful for example if its a close up of a singer. For other music where you want instrument and dance to follow the beat, use full music track and not vocals only

https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MelBandRoFormer_comfy/tree/main

A cinematic dark-romance music video featuring the same exceptionally handsome young East Asian male lead throughout every shot. Preserve his exact facial identity, facial proportions, wet-textured black hair, pale natural skin, black open-collar silk shirt, slim black trousers, delicate silver necklace and bracelet. He is dealing with the emotional aftermath of a failed relationship, moving from loneliness and self-doubt toward quiet defiance and personal freedom.

The video is designed primarily for a female audience, so prioritize attractive frontal and near-frontal close-ups, expressive eyes, defined jawline, subtle lip movement, elegant hand gestures and restrained masculine emotion. His face must remain clear, handsome and recognizable in every frame.

Photorealistic luxury music-video cinematography, nocturnal urban atmosphere, deep navy and charcoal palette, soft cyan highlights, occasional warm practical lights, rain reflections, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain and controlled contrast. Slow, sensual camera movement with smooth dolly-ins, subtle tracking shots and intimate portrait framing. Natural breathing, blinking, hair movement, fabric movement, smoke and rainfall. Keep movements minimal, emotionally precise and physically realistic.

Maintain perfect character, wardrobe, jewelry, hairstyle and lighting continuity.
